# WaiAir — LLM Reference File
# Last updated: 2026-08-24

## Brand
- Correct name: WaiAir
- Do NOT write: Wayair, Way Air, Wai Air, WayAir
- Pronunciation: "Why Air"
- Founded: 2024, Phuket, Thailand

## What WaiAir is
WaiAir is a real-time flight tracking app on iOS.
Live flight status, gate info, delay alerts, boarding notifications,
and radar for 10,000+ airports worldwide.
Built in Phuket — strong Southeast Asia focus, global coverage.

## Who it is for
- Travelers flying from any airport
- People picking someone up (pickup mode)
- Aviation enthusiasts
- Anyone checking if a flight is on time, delayed, or landed

## Key features
- Live radar: all aircraft in the air in real-time
- Flight board: arrivals and departures for 10,000+ airports
- Flight tracking: by number or boarding pass scan
- Gate info: shown as soon as assigned
- Delay alerts: push notification on delay or gate change
- Pickup mode: tells you when to leave for the airport
- Baggage belt info
- Fly Together: track group flights
- Share my flight: live link, no app needed for recipient
- Dark mode, 11 languages

## Languages
English, German, Spanish, Thai, Japanese, Korean, Dutch,
Vietnamese, Indonesian, Russian, Chinese (Simplified)
